base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_020" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female' AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
HAVING COUNT(T3."XCL_013") > 15
ORDER BY T5."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN 
    hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN 
    attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
JOIN 
    hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
WHERE 
    g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
    AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
GROUP BY 
    s.XCL_018, s.XCL_019, s.XCL_020
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.XCL_013) > 15
ORDER BY 
    ha.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 1
